reasons.plausibility: The concept of a thin carbide interlayer to reduce interface thermal resistance and maintain mechanical and irradiation properties seems scientifically sound with only minor uncertainties about the extent of the conductivity increase.
reasons.testability: The proposed direct comparison of WC-coated vs. uncoated W–Cu composites under realistic conditions, with explicit metrics and a clear falsification threshold, makes the test feasibility and criteria strong.
reasons.usefulness: This hypothesis offers a focused, practical intervention that directly addresses the key challenge of improving thermal conductivity without compromising durability and irradiation resistance.
